title: Zesty Earthy Venezuelan Mars Bar Tart
description: A rich and decadent dessert featuring mars bar, with earthy undertones and a romantic venezuelan twist, made with sous-vide technique for a perfectly set filling.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine the graham cracker crumbs, confectioners sugar, and melted earth balance butter, and blend until well combined.
Press the crumb mixture into the bottom of a 9 inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, vanilla extract, and chopped mars bar.
Pour the egg mixture into the prepared tart crust.
Place the tart into a sous-vide safe bag, and seal the bag, removing as much air as possible.
Place the bag into a water bath, and cook for 2 hours.
Remove the tart from the bag, and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the tart for at least 2 hours before serving.
Slice the tart into 12 equal pieces, and serve chilled.
